messages.detail: New Arcadia sustained healthy finances, employment, utilities, and livability for 12 consecutive days. The Charter is permanent; a Regional Capital mandate arrives by Day 235.

messages.detail: 3 Residential lots cleared their recorded storm damage. Current protection: 23% utility reserve, 1 park, and 0 emergency services. Keep utilities healthy to protect the recovery; Commercial and Industrial conditions were unchanged.

messages.detail: Next decision: protect recovery by keeping utility reserve at or above 15%, or invest in a park or emergency service. Consequence: Emergency repairs cost $2,000, happiness fell 3 points, and weathered 3 completed homes at blocks 4, 11; 7, 11; 10, 11. Diagnosis: 24% utility reserve, 1 park, and 0 emergency services limited average damage to 30%. Objective: keep utilities fully covered with at least 15% reserve while parks and emergency services accelerate Residential repairs until all recorded storm damage clears.
